# 3D text poster maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/text-3d/

Create a text poster with layered vector extrusion, color controls and an editable background, then download PNG or SVG.

## How to use it

1. Choose your image or enter your own text.
2. Pick a layout, style or output size.
3. Create the result and download your shareable image.

## Example

Design a short word with twelve shadow layers and a contrasting foreground color.

## Limits and checks

This is a layered 2D illustration of depth, not a 3D model. Exported text appearance can vary when a different system substitutes the font.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
